data.name: Jabbarnisa
data.long_meaning: Jabbarnisa is a beautiful and strong name meaning 'Gem of the sea' in Islamic tradition. It is derived from the Arabic words 'Jabbar' (great, powerful) and 'Nisa' (woman), conveying the idea of a woman of immense strength and beauty, like a precious gem found in the depths of the sea.
